Title: IBS: If Bloating or Diarrhea Keep Coming Back - 3 Habits Worth Checking

Description:
An estimated 25 to 45 million Americans live with IBS, a gut-brain axis disorder. Three everyday habits make it worse: chronic stress, which disrupts gut motility and raises pain sensitivity; fatty and fried foods, which trigger stronger gut contractions; and alcohol, which speeds up motility and irritates the gut lining. Slow breathing, lighter meals, and fewer drinks can all help calm your gut.
